text: And here we are, finally home.
It's still like that.
This is the quietest place on earth.
You will see for yourself.
It's so beautiful. There's no one here.
We are here.
Three men cannot get it together in one day.
Why can't we? Of course, we can.
Strange, the flowers have no scent.
Don't you feel it?
It stinks like a swamp.
No, it is a river.

There were flowerbeds here, there were flowerbeds here,
But a porcupine trampled on them.
But their scent lingered for many years.
Why did he destroy them?
I don't know.
I asked him why.
He said, "One day you will understand."
I think he just started hating the zone.
Is Porcupine his real name?
No, a nickname. Like yours.

For many years he led people into the Zone,
And no one could stop him.
He was my teacher.
He opened my eyes.
Then they did not call him a porcupine, but teacher.

Then something happened to him.
Something broke inside him.
I think that he was punished.
Help me. Tie the bandage strips to these metal nuts.
I'll just take a walk.
I need ...
Be careful when you come here.
Where did he go?
Maybe he just wants to be alone.

Why? Even with the three of us here,
I feel awkward.

He returned to the Zone.
Remember, he is a stalker.
So what?
You see, pursuit is a kind of calling.

- I imagined stalkers would be different.
- How so?
Like a stroller or Chingachgook or the big snake.
Our stalker's biography is even more horrific.

He had been in prison several times,
And he was damaged here.
His daughter is a mutant, a so-called victim of the Zone.
They say she has no legs.
What did he mean by Porcupine?
What did he mean when he said he was punished?
Is that a figure of speech?
One fine day,
Porcupine returned from this place
and suddenly became rich.
Incredibly rich.
You call this a punishment?
Within a week, he hanged himself.

- Why?
- Quiet!
What is this?
